title: 6:45AM MORNING POWERFUL PRAYER TO COMMAND THE NEW MONTH
text: Oh, I feel the weight of this moment. I feel the density of the spirit in this place. Something is about to happen. Something is shifting even before I open my mouth to teach. The heavens already responding. The angels already at attention. And wherever you are right now, whatever screen you are watching this from, whatever room you are sitting in, whatever nation, whatever city, I want you to know that the God who transcends geography is standing right next to you. He did not send a representative. He came himself. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Baruch Hashem Adonai. Blessed be the name of the Lord. I want you to do something before we go one step further. Stretch your hands toward heaven. Just lift them. Lift them as a sign of surrender. As a sign that says, "Lord, whatever you want to do in this moment, I am available. I am not here by accident. I am here by assignment, and I will not leave until something changes." Father, we bless you. We magnify your name. You are El Elyon, the most high God. You are El Shaddai, the God who is more than enough. You are Jehovah Gibbor, the mighty warrior. And we come before you at the threshold of a new month. We come not casually. We come with intention. We come with fire. We come with expectation because you are a God who honors expectation. You are a God who responds to faith. And tonight, our faith is making a demand on your power. Hallelujah. Now, sit. Sit down for a moment. Calm your spirit. Let me lay a foundation. Because what we're about to do tonight is not ordinary prayer. We're about to engage in something that very few believers understand. We're about to command a month. And I need you to stay with me. Whether this is your first time hearing a message like this or you have walked with God for 40 years, the spirit has something fresh, something you have not heard before. Something that when it enters your spirit will change the way you approach time for the rest of your life. And before I forget, share this. Share this right now. Put the link in your family group chat. Put it on your status. Send it to that friend who is going through a hard season. Send it to that person who has been struggling month after month after month with no change. God might use this very message to snap the chain off their life. Do not hold the fire. Spread it. Now, open your Bible with me. I want to show you something from the book of Job chapter 38. And I want to read from verses 12 through 13. God is speaking directly to Job. And he says, "Has thou commanded the morning since thy days? And caused the day spring to know his place? That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and the wicked be shaken out of it?" Did you see what God just revealed? He asked Job, "Have you commanded the morning?" In other words, God was saying, "Job, there is a dimension of authority that I gave to man, the ability to command time, the ability to speak to the morning and instruct it. The ability to tell the dawn where to position itself. And when you command the morning, something happens to the wicked, they are shaken out." >> [music] >> That word shaken in the Hebrew carries the image of someone shaking a garment to remove dust, to remove insects, to remove parasites. God is saying that when you command the morning, when you command the beginning of a season, the parasites that have been clinging to your life, the spiritual leeches, the demonic hitchhikers, the unseen entities feeding on your progress, they are violently shaken off. And I want to submit to you tonight that if you can command the morning of a day, you can command the morning of a month. Because a month is simply a collection of days. And the first day of that month is the morning of the entire 30 days. What you do on day one determines the trajectory of day two through day 31. How you enter the month is how the month will carry you. This is not superstition. This is not religious tradition. This is biblical apostolic prophetic authority being exercised over the dimension of time. Let me show you another scripture before we go further. Lamentations chapter 3 verse 23. The prophet Jeremiah in the middle of his weeping, in the middle of the destruction of Jerusalem, in the middle of the worst season of his life made this declaration. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Now, why is that significant? Because Jeremiah was saying that God packages his mercies in mornings. Every morning and by extension every new month comes loaded with a fresh deposit of mercy. It is preloaded. Before the month begins, before you open your eyes on the first day, mercy has already been assigned. Compassion has already been allocated. Grace has already been measured out. But here is what many believers miss. The mercy is available, but it must be accessed. It must be drawn out. And the mechanism for drawing it out is prayer. Specifically commanding prayer, declarative prayer. The kind of prayer that does not beg, it decrees. The kind of prayer that does not whimper, it commands. Because you are not approaching God as a stranger, you approaching as a son, you approaching as a daughter. You approaching as one who has been seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principality and power and might and dominion. Ephesians 2:6. You have authority. And I need somebody to understand this tonight because it is going to change the way you pray. There is a difference between petitionary prayer and legislative prayer. Petitionary prayer says, "God, please help me." And there is nothing wrong with that. There are seasons for petition. But legislative prayer says, in the name of Jesus, I decree that this month shall produce my harvest. I command every door to open. I instruct every gate to lift. I speak to the four winds and I say bring my blessings from the north, the south, the east and the west. That is not arrogance. That is the exercise of delegated authority. Jesus said in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt you." He said, "I give unto you." The power is transferred. It is delegated. It is deposited in your spirit by the Holy Ghost and tonight we are going to use it. Are you ready? Because the spirit of God is about to take this to another level. Let me show you one more thing before we pray because I believe in building the foundation of understanding so that when you pray, you pray with intelligence. You pray with revelation. You pray with a legal framework that the courts of heaven recognize. Turn with me to Ezekiel chapter 37. This is the famous valley of dry bones. And the Lord said to Ezekiel in verse 4, "Prophesy upon these bones and say unto them, oh you dry bones, hear the word of the Lord." God did not say Ezekiel, pray about the bones. He said, "Prophesy to the bones." He did not say Ezekiel, fast for 40 days and maybe something will change. He said, "Open your mouth and speak to the dead situation." And here is the revelation. The bones were dead. They had no life. They had no capacity to respond. They had no ears. They had no heartbeat. But when the prophet opened his mouth and released the word of the Lord, life entered them. Bone connected to bone, sinew appeared, flesh covered them, breath entered them, and they stood up as an exceedingly great army. I want you to understand what just happened. A dead situation was reversed by the spoken word of a man who carried the spirit of God. And that is what you are about to do tonight. You are about to prophesy to a month that has not yet begun. You are about to speak to 30 days that are still in the womb of time. You are about to command life where there has been death, increase where there has been decrease, favor where there has been rejection, open doors where there have been walls. And the month will hear you because the word of God in your mouth carries the same creative power that said, "Let there be light." And there was light. Genesis 1:3. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, listen carefully. There are dimensions to what we are about to do. This is not a prayer you rush through. This is not something you do while scrolling your phone. Put everything down, close every tab, silence every notification because the next minutes of your life are going to determine the next 30 days. What you decree tonight, heaven will enforce tomorrow. What you bind tonight, hell cannot loose tomorrow. What you loose tonight, no principality can bind tomorrow. Thus saith the spirit of God, I want to speak prophetically before we pray. The Lord is telling me that there are people connected to this moment right now who almost did not make it through the last month. I am not talking about finances. I am not talking about relationships. I am talking about your will to live. Some of you were at the edge. You were at the border of giving up, not just on a project or a dream, but on life itself. The darkness was so thick. The pressure was so heavy, and nobody knew, nobody saw it. You smiled on Sunday and wept on Monday. You posted victories on social media and fought battles in your bedroom. But the Lord says, I kept you. Psalm 121 verses 7 through 8. The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. He says, the fact that you are hearing this word right now is proof that I did not abandon you. I held you when you could not hold yourself. And this new month, it is my response to your pain. It is my answer to your tears. What the last month tried to destroy, this new month will restore. Receive that. Receive it deeply. And there is somebody else the spirit of God is showing me you have been praying about something for so long that you have grown tired of your own voice. You have said the same prayer so many times that the words taste stale in your mouth. And you have begun to wonder, does God even hear me? Am I talking to the ceiling? But the Lord says, Daniel 10:12, from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard. He says, I heard you the first time. The delay was not denial. The delay was warfare in the heavenly realm. But the angel has broken through. The answer is being released. And in this new month, you will hold in your hands what you have been holding in your heart. Somebody shout Hallelujah right where you are. Now we pray, and we do not pray timidly. We pray with the authority of heaven. We pray with the fire of the Holy Ghost. We pray as those who have been given dominion. Genesis 1:28, God said, have dominion. That dominion extends over time. It extends over months and seasons and years. So open your mouth and pray with me. Father, >> [music] >> in the mighty, matchless, undefeatable name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I approach the throne of grace with boldness, not with timidity, not with uncertainty. Hebrews 4:16, I come boldly because the blood of Jesus has given me access, the blood of Jesus has given me a voice, the blood of Jesus has given me standing in the courts of heaven. And I am exercising that standing right now. I speak to this new month. I address you as one who has been given authority over you. You are not a random collection of days. You are a divine container. You are a vessel carrying the purposes of God for my life. And I command you align with heaven's agenda. Align with the blueprint that was written before the foundation of the world. Align with the thoughts God thinks toward me, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give me an expected end. Jeremiah 29:11, I decree and I declare this month is my month of manifestation. Every promise God has spoken over my life, it manifests this month. Every prophecy that has been declared over my destiny, it comes to pass this month. Every seed I have sown in tears, I reap the harvest this month. Psalm 126:5, they that sow in tears shall reap in joy. I am reaping. I am reaping. I am reaping. Not next year, not next quarter, this month. This month. This month carries my harvest. Now, begin to pray in the spirit. Let your prayer language rise. Let the Holy Ghost intercede through you. Shondalarikiya mabasi koramah. Shakandalaberishino senkiyah. Rabakoshama la yirisendobah. Hallelujah. I am praying now over your finances. Hear the word of the Lord. Philippians 4:19, "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus, not according to the economy, not according to your salary, not according to the exchange rate, according to his riches in glory. And his riches in glory are inexhaustible. So, I speak to every financial gate, I speak to every door of provision, I command them to open not by might, not by power, but by the spirit of the living God. Zechariah 4:6, I decree that money flows toward you this month. Contracts that have been stalled release now. Clients that have been silent, they call this month. Business ideas that have been dormant, they ignite this month. Debts that have piled up, supernatural cancellation begins this month. I break the power of every spirit of financial lack. I break the power of every spirit of wastage, where money comes in and disappears without trace. I break the power of the devourer. Malachi 3:11, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground." I invoke that scripture over your finances. The devourer is rebuked. Your money will not vanish, your investments will not collapse, your business will not fail. The hand of God is upon your finances, and it is a hand of multiplication. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is giving me a specific word. You have been debating whether to take a particular financial step, an investment, a property, a business expansion, and fear has held you back. But the Lord says, "This is the month. I am backing it. Move forward. The resources will come, the wisdom will come. I am your senior partner in this venture." Receive it if it is for you. And there There someone else you lost money recently. A significant amount through fraud, through betrayal, through a bad deal, and it has left you devastated. But the Lord says, Joel 2:25, "I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten." He says, "What was taken will be returned, not in the same form, but in greater measure. The thief has been caught." Proverbs 6:31, "He must restore sevenfold." Watch what I am about to do with your finances this month. Hallelujah. Now I shift. I'm moving to the area of health and the physical body, and I am praying with the authority of Isaiah 53:5, "By his stripes we are healed." That healing was purchased over 2,000 years ago on a cross in Jerusalem. It is not a future promise. It is a finished work, and tonight I am activating it over everybody connected to this moment. I speak to sickness. I speak to disease. I speak to infirmity. I speak to pain. I speak to diagnosis. Hear the decree of the Lord, you have no right to stay. Your lease has expired. Your legal ground is revoked, for the body you are tormenting belongs to the Lord Jesus Christ. 1 Corinthians 6:19, it is the temple of the Holy Ghost, and no sickness can inhabit the temple of God. I command cancer cells to die right now. I command tumors to shrink. I command blood pressure to normalize. I command sugar levels to stabilize. I command hormonal systems to recalibrate. I command reproductive systems to function as God designed them. I speak to blocked tubes, open now. I speak to low sperm count, life enters now. I speak to every fibroid, every cyst, every polyp dissolve now in the name of Jesus. Somebody's kidney is being healed right now. I see it in the spirit. You have been dealing with kidney issues, the pain in your lower back, the changes in your urine, the fatigue, but the healing hand of the Lord is on your kidneys right now. Receive it. Both kidneys are functioning. Both kidneys are whole. The blood of Jesus is flushing every toxin, every infection, every abnormality out of your system. And there is somebody the Lord is showing me you have been scheduled for a surgery. You have a date already booked, but the Lord says let me be your surgeon. Before the date arrives, go back and let them run the test again. They will search for what they found and it will not be there because I am Jehovah Rapha. I am the Lord who heals you. Exodus 15:26. Pray. Pray with faith. Lay your hands on whatever part of your body needs healing and release your faith. Rabash akai aro shendu la be. Shikora laia masendri bakola. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I move now into the area of spiritual warfare because listen, a new month is a new territory. And when you cross into new territory, there are gatekeepers. There are spiritual checkpoints. There are principalities and powers that have been assigned to that month not by God but by the kingdom of darkness to resist the advancement of God's people. Ephesians 6:12. We wrestle not against flesh and blood but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. And so I engage. I engage the battle not with fear but with fire. Every principality assigned to resist my progress this month, I pull you down. Second Corinthians 10:4. The weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. I pull down every stronghold of delay. I pull down every stronghold of stagnation. I pull down every stronghold of confusion. I pull down every stronghold of financial blockage. I pull down every stronghold of marital hindrance. I pull down every stronghold of sickness. They are coming down tonight. They are not surviving this prayer. Every evil altar that has been erected against your life in this new month, I command fire from heaven to consume it. Elijah prayed on Mount Carmel and fire fell. 1 Kings 18:38, "Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust and licked up the water that was in the trench." >> [music] >> If God's fire could consume stones and water, it can consume every altar of witchcraft that has been set up in someone's village, in someone's family, in someone's compound, fire fall. Fire fall. Fire fall now. I destroy every cauldron. I overturn every pot. I scatter every coven meeting that has been convened to discuss your destiny. Every name that has been mentioned on a dark altar, I erase it with the blood of Jesus. Your name is written in the Lamb's Book of Life. Revelation 21:27. That is the only register that matters. Every other register where your name has been enrolled by witchcraft, I cancel that enrollment now. Every curse that has been pronounced over this month, whether by a jealous colleague, a bitter relative, an envious neighbor, a wicked ex, I reverse it. Numbers 23:23, "There is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. What God has blessed, no man can curse. What God has ordained, no demon can cancel. And God has blessed you. God has ordained favor over this month. And no tongue, no spell, no incantation can change what God has said. I break every covenant of death. Isaiah 28:18, your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand. I am speaking to family covenants, generational agreements, things your ancestors entered into that you are now paying for, blood that was shed on dark altars, animals that were sacrificed in rituals, dedications that were made over babies in occultic ceremonies, whatever was done, I dissolve it tonight. The blood of Jesus dissolves it. The fire of the Holy Ghost consumes it. You are free. Free from inherited bondage, free from ancestral limitations, free from the sins of your fathers and your fathers' fathers. Exodus 20:5 says that the iniquity of the fathers can visit the children to the third and fourth generation. But Ezekiel 18:20 says, "The soul that sinneth, it shall die." The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father. Under the new covenant through the blood of Jesus, the generational chain is broken. Tonight, it is broken. Not loosened, not weakened, broken, shattered, destroyed, irreversible. Pray. Pray like your freedom depends on it, because it does. Shondala bayiriko ramashikindu rabashiki normala sendri bakola rikiya. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am not slowing down. The spirit is not slowing down. There is more. There is more. I speak now to marriages and relationships. I feel the anointing strong on this area. There are marriages that the enemy has targeted for destruction in this new month. He has planned arguments, he has planned misunderstandings, he has planned the entrance of third parties. He has planned temptation, he has planned separation, but I decree by the authority of heaven what God has joined together, let no man put asunder. Matthew 19:6. I speak peace into troubled marriages. Where there has been silence, I release communication. Where there has been suspicion, I release trust. Where there has been coldness, I release warmth. Where there has been unfaithfulness, I release conviction and repentance. Where the enemy has planted a seed of divorce, I uproot it tonight. That seed will not germinate, that seed will not take root, it dies in the ground. And for those who are believing God for a spouse this month, the Lord says, "Open your eyes. I am moving pieces on the board. The person I have prepared for you is closer than you think. Do not look with your natural eyes, look with the eyes of the spirit. I am arranging a divine encounter. Be sensitive, be available, be ready, for the meeting will seem natural, but it is engineered by heaven." I pray for every womb that has been shut. Hannah cried out to God and God opened her womb. 1 Samuel 1:20. And the same God who remembered Hannah is remembering someone tonight. I decree barrenness is over. The medical report is overruled. What the doctor said is impossible, God says it's already done. A child is coming, a pregnancy is coming. Before this year is over, you will carry your baby. You will hold your baby. You will nurse your baby, and the name of the Lord will be glorified. Someone the Lord is saying to me, "Your Your is connected to the word double. Where you have experienced loss, the Lord is giving you double. Isaiah 61:7, "For your shame you shall have double, and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion. Therefore, in their land they shall possess the double. Everlasting joy shall be unto them." This month initiates the double portion, not single, double. Where you lost one, two are coming. Where one door closed, two are opening. The God of the double portion is at work. Hallelujah. I pray now over your children. If you are a parent, if you are a guardian, if you are responsible for young ones, I cover them with the blood of Jesus. Isaiah 54:13, "All thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children." I decree peace over your children this month. No accident will touch them. No sickness will afflict them. No bad influence will corrupt them. No predator will reach them. They are fenced in by the blood of Jesus. Angels are assigned to them. Psalm 91:11, they are protected, they are preserved, they are guided. For those whose children have gone astray, prodigal sons and prodigal daughters, I decree the turning. The turning has come. The rebellion is breaking. The scales are falling from their eyes. The Holy Spirit is convicting them even as I speak. And like the prodigal son in Luke 15, they are coming to their senses. They are turning their faces toward home. Do not give up on them. Do not stop praying. This month you will see a shift. Now, I want to pray over your mind because the mind is the battleground. 2 Corinthians 10:5, "Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalted itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ." I bind every spirit of depression that has been assigned to someone's life this month. I bind every spirit of anxiety. I bind every spirit of fear. I bind every spirit of suicidal thought. I bind every spirit of confusion and mental torment. You are not welcome. You are trespassing on blood-bought territory. The mind of the believer is the territory of the Holy Ghost and you are evicted. Philippians 4:8 Whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely. Whatsoever things are of good report, if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things. I decree that this month your mind is filled with truth. Your thoughts are ordered by the spirit. Confusion lifts. Clarity enters. You know what to do. You know where to go. You know what decisions to make. The fog is gone. Someone the Lord is telling me you have been overthinking a particular decision. You have gone back and forth, back and forth until you are dizzy. But the Lord says Proverbs 3:5-6, "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding." In all thy ways acknowledge him and he shall direct thy paths. He says, "Stop analyzing. Trust me. The answer I put in your spirit 3 weeks ago, that is the answer. Move on it this month." Rabakoshimaya layerosendri shakarabelama sikorama. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I decree over your career. I decree over your profession. I decree over your calling. Whatever your hands find to do this month, it prospers. Psalm 1:3, "Whatsoever he doeth shall prosper." Not some things, whatsoever. Everything, every project, every initiative, every application, every presentation, every proposal, every creative work, it prospers. The blessing of the Lord is upon it. I speak to those who have been overlooked at work, promotion is coming. I speak to those whose talents have been ignored, recognition is coming. I speak to those who have been doing the work while others take the credit. This month, God puts a spotlight on you. The hidden season is over. Your gift is making room for you. Proverbs 18:16, "A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men." You are coming before great men this month. Not by manipulation, not by networking, not by begging, by the sovereign hand of God. He's positioning you, he's promoting you. He's opening conversations about you in rooms you have never entered. People you have never met are about to become instruments of your breakthrough. And for students, those in school, those preparing for examinations, those working toward degrees, the Lord says, Isaiah 11:2, "The spirit of wisdom and understanding shall rest upon you. Your mind will be sharp, your memory will be strong, your comprehension will be clear." You will read and you will retain. You will sit in that examination hall and the Holy Spirit himself will bring things to your remembrance. John 14:26, "You will excel not by your own strength, but by the power of the spirit of God working through your intellect." I decree I seal it. It is done. Now, I want to address something the spirit of God is pressing upon my heart, and it concerns divine timing, because some of you have struggled with this concept. You feel like God is late. You feel like the bus has left without you. You look at your age and you calculate how much time you have lost and the numbers terrify you. But I want to tell you what the Bible says. Ecclesiastes 3:1 to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. God has not forgotten your purpose. He has assigned it a time and this month may very well be the time, the kairos moment, the appointed hour, the fullness of time. Galatians 4:4 says when the fullness of the time was come, God sent forth his son. Jesus did not come early. He did not come late. He came at the exact moment heaven had determined. And in the same way, your breakthrough is not early and it is not late. It is right on time. God's clock is never wrong. So I speak to every virtue that has been stolen by delay, I command it to return. I speak to every opportunity that expired before you could seize it. I decree resurrection over those opportunities. They are coming back in new forms, in better forms, in forms that exceed the original. What the enemy stole at 20, God is restoring at 30. What was taken at 30, God is multiplying at 40. Your latter shall be greater than your former. Haggai 2:9. I speak to wasted years. Joel 2:25 is activated over your life tonight. The years the locust ate returned. The years the cankerworm consumed returned. The years the palmerworm devoured returned. Not just the time, the opportunities, the connections, the resources, the joy, the peace. Everything that was lost in those years, it is all been returned in compressed form. What should take 10 years, God will accomplish in in months. What should take 5 years, God will accomplish in 5 weeks. Acceleration is your portion. Acceleration is your inheritance. Receive it. Hallelujah. I am nearing the closing of this ministration, but the spirit is not done. There is fire still burning. There is more to release. I want to speak to those who are in ministry, pastors, teachers, evangelists, worship leaders, intercessors, those who serve behind the scenes. The Lord sees your labor. Hebrews 6:10. God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labor of love, which you have showed toward his name, in that you have ministered to the saints and do minister. He has not forgotten. He has recorded every sacrifice, every late night, every personal need you set aside to meet someone else's need, every tear you cried in private while preaching victory in public. This month, the Lord says, "I am refreshing you." Isaiah 40:31. They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint. Fresh strength is coming. Fresh anointing is coming. Fresh vision is coming. You will not burn out. You will not break down. You will not give up. The fire that called you is the fire that sustains you. And for those who have been feeling spiritually dry, like the heavens are brass, like your prayers are bouncing off the ceiling, like the fire that once burned in your spirit has dimmed to an ember, the Lord says, "I am about to pour water on the thirsty ground." Isaiah 44:3. "I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground. I will pour my spirit upon thy seed." The dryness is ending. This month, the rain falls. This month, the river flows. This month, the fire reignites. You will worship again with tears of joy. You will pray again with power. You will hear my voice again with clarity. Receive the fresh fire. Receive the fresh oil. Receive the fresh wind of the Holy Ghost. Rabash shondala kiaro shakindala berishima kolasendra. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, I seal. I seal this entire prayer with the blood of Jesus. Every word that has been spoken tonight, I seal it. Every decree that has been released, I seal it. Every prophecy that has gone forth, I seal it. Not with human authority. With the authority of the risen Christ who said in Matthew 28:18, "All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth." On the basis of that power, that all-encompassing, undefeatable, irresistible power, I declare that this new month bows to the lordship of Jesus Christ in your life. This month, you will not bury anyone. This month, you will not be hospitalized. This month, you will not be scammed. This month, you will not be betrayed beyond recovery. This month, you will not weep tears of sorrow. This month, evil will not locate your address. This month, tragedy will not know your name. This month, death will pass over your household like it passed over Israel on the night of the first Passover, Exodus 12. The blood is on your doorpost. The blood is speaking on your behalf. And the destroyer cannot enter. I decree open heavens over your life. Deuteronomy 28:12, "The Lord opens unto you his good treasure." Not ordinary treasure, good treasure. The best of heaven. The finest of God's provision. It is opened over you this month. You are walking under an open heaven. Blessings are raining down. favor is pouring out, opportunities are falling at your feet. Divine appointments are filling your calendar. The month is pregnant with miracles and it is about to deliver. I speak to every person under the sound of my voice and I say the siege is over. The long night is over. The season of tears is over. The season of shame is over. The season of begging is over. The season of barely surviving is over. This month you are not surviving, you are thriving, you are flourishing, you are expanding, you are increasing, you are laughing, you are testifying. You are standing before people and saying, "Let me tell you what the Lord has done." Psalm 40:1-3. I waited patiently for the Lord and he inclined unto me and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock and established my goings. And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God. Many shall see it and fear and shall trust in the Lord. A new song is in your mouth, not the old song of complaint, not the old song of defeat, a new song, a song of victory, a song of breakthrough, a song of testimony. And people around you, your neighbors, your colleagues, your family, they will see the change and they will be amazed and their amazement will lead them to God. Your life this month becomes a sermon.
